invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.footer: Hours are from the approved timesheets for the service period. Amounts are computed from whole minutes and rounded once per line.

banner.demo: Demo agency with invented data. Nothing here is real, and the demo makes no outside calls.
banner.resetBody: Every upload, review and file made in the demo is removed, and the demo agency starts over.

upload.dropBody: Photos (JPG, PNG, HEIC), PDFs, time-clock exports (CSV, XLSX) and VMS exports. Up to 25 MB each.
upload.processingBody: {count, plural, one {# file is} other {# files are}} being read.
upload.unsupported: This file type is not accepted
upload.archiveBody: Its hours are not paid or billed. Say why, for example that the same hours are in another file.
upload.stuck: Reading stopped before it finished. Read it again, or archive it if its hours are elsewhere.

hours.sectionBody: Each row is one worker's day, read from the timesheets. Rows that need a person's check are shown first.
hours.approveSelectedNote: {skipped, plural, =0 {} one {# selected row is not high confidence and stays as it is.} other {# selected rows are not high confidence and stay as they are.}}
hours.reasonBody: The reason is kept with the change in the audit log.
hours.blockersTitle: {count, plural, one {# entry needs attention before totals} other {# entries need attention before totals}}

reasons.in_after_out: Time out is not after time in
reasons.break_longer_than_shift: Break is longer than the shift
reasons.total_mismatch: Written total does not match the times
reasons.seen_by_one_pass: Only one reading found this row
reasons.inconsistent_reading: Reading does not fit what is written
reasons.row_total_mismatch: Worker's written weekly total does not match
reasons.grand_total_mismatch: Sheet's written grand total does not match
reasons.duplicate_day_in_vms: Day appears on more than one VMS sheet
reasons.assignment_at_other_client: The worker's assignment that day is at another client
reasons.timesheet_client_unclear: Which client this timesheet is for is unclear
reasons.assignment_at_other_client_named: The worker's assignment that day is at {client}; edit to attach these hours there if they are theirs
reasons.timesheet_client_unclear_named: Which client this timesheet is for is unclear; the worker's assignment that day is at {client}. Edit to attach these hours there if they are theirs

editErrors.not_editable: This entry can no longer be changed.
editErrors.date_outside_period: The date must be inside the pay period.
editErrors.out_not_after_in: Time out must be after time in.
editErrors.crosses_midnight: The shift runs past midnight; enter each day separately.
editErrors.break_too_long: The break is as long as the shift or longer.
editErrors.no_assignment: That worker has no active assignment on that date.
editErrors.several_assignments: That worker has more than one active assignment on that date.
editErrors.period_locked: This period's files were already created; its hours can no longer change.
editErrors.period_busy: Someone else is changing this pay period right now. Try again in a moment.
editErrors.assignment_at_other_client: {count, plural, one {That worker's assignment on that date is at {client}} other {That worker's assignments on that date are at {client}}}, not this timesheet's client.
editErrors.timesheet_client_unclear: Which client this timesheet is for is unclear. {count, plural, one {That worker's assignment on that date is at {client}.} other {That worker's assignments on that date are at {client}.}}
editErrors.attach_client_unavailable: That worker has no assignment at that client on that date, so the hours stay where they are.

hours.approveRefused: This entry can't be approved yet. Fix its worker, date or hours first.
hours.historyAttachedUnclear: Attached to {client} (this timesheet's client is unclear)

totals.skipWorkers: {count, plural, one {Skip this worker for this run} other {Skip these # workers for this run}}
totals.skipBody: Skipped workers are not in this payroll file or these invoices. Pay them separately.
totals.skippedTitle: {count, plural, one {# worker skipped} other {# workers skipped}}

blockers.unmatched_entry: Entries not matched to a worker
blockers.entry_incomplete: Entries are missing a date or hours
blockers.invalid_input: Hours that cannot be paid as entered
blockers.unknown_jurisdiction: No wage rules for the worksite's state
blockers.rule_not_supported_yet: A wage rule Shiftbook does not handle yet
blockers.multiple_pay_rates_with_overtime: Overtime with more than one pay rate
blockers.possible_duplicate_day: Days that may be counted twice
blockers.export_refused: The payroll file would be refused
blockers.period_not_aligned: The pay period does not match the workweek
blockers.document_failed: Timesheets that could not be read
blockers.premium_not_applicable: A confirmed premium that does not apply here
blockers.approaching_equal_pay_hours: Nearing 720 hours at one Illinois client
blockers.equal_pay_rate_missing: Hours after 720 at one client without an equal-pay rate

totals.bothRealBody: Confirm these entries are different work on the same day, not the same hours read twice. If either entry changes later, this is asked again.

files.successBody: The payroll file and invoices for this period are ready. The period is now locked; changes start a new version.

errors.busy: Someone else is changing this pay period right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
errors.notReady: The run still has problems to resolve.
errors.periodLocked: This period's files were already created, so its hours and totals can no longer change.
errors.stale: This changed in another tab or window. The page now shows the latest.
errors.totalsChanged: The totals changed since you looked at them. Review them again, then create the files.

form.draftBody: The draft stays in this browser and comes back the next time you create a job order.

errors.worksite: Choose one of this client's worksites.
errors.headcount: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10,000.
errors.pay_range: Enter amounts like 18.50, with the first not above the second.
errors.client_has_assignments: Workers are assigned to this job order, so its client cannot change.

jobOrder.ratesLine: Pay {pay} an hour, bill {bill} an hour, since {from}.
jobOrder.noRateToday: No rate is in force today, so hours on this job order cannot be paid.
jobOrder.assignmentsLine: {count, plural, =0 {No workers} one {# worker} other {# workers}} on it now, of {wanted} wanted.
jobOrder.ownRatesBody: These rates apply to this worker on this job order from their start date; on other dates the job order's rates apply.

assignments.title: Assignments
assignments.ended: {count, plural, one {# assignment ended} other {# assignments ended}}.
assignments.endTitle: {count, plural, one {End this assignment} other {End # assignments}}
assignments.endBody: Hours after the end date will not be paid on this assignment. Weeks already paid stay as they are.
assignments.cancelBody: A cancelled assignment is never paid or billed. It can only be cancelled if none of its hours were paid.
assignments.assignBody: Pick a worker from the roster and the dates.
assignments.assignedSoFar: Assigned: {names}. Add another, or choose Done.

errors.worker_not_found: That worker is not on the roster.
errors.job_order_not_found: That job order no longer exists.
errors.invalid_date: Enter the dates as full dates.
errors.end_before_start: The end date is before the start date.
errors.overlaps: {name} already has an assignment on this job order for those dates.
errors.paid_outside: Some of {name}'s hours on this assignment were already paid, so the dates must still include them.
errors.has_paid_hours: Some of {name}'s hours on this assignment were already paid, so it cannot be cancelled. End it instead.

rates.title: Rate card
rates.frozenWhy: Weeks up to {date} were paid with this version, so it cannot change. Add a new version instead.
rates.none: No rate card yet. Hours on this job order are held until it has one.
rates.deleteBody: The version from {date} is removed and the version before it covers its dates.
rates.startsAfter: Weeks up to {date} were paid, so a new version starts after that.
rates.anyDate: No week has been paid with these rates yet.
rates.willSchedule: This starts after today, so it is scheduled.

reasons.wrong_from_start: It was wrong from the start
reasons.client_agreed: The client agreed a new rate

errors.ot_multiplier: Enter a multiplier from 1 to 10, like 1.5.
errors.dt_multiplier: Enter a multiplier from 1 to 10, like 2.
errors.same_start: Another version already starts on that day.
errors.paid: Weeks up to {date} were already paid with these rates; start after that day.
errors.earliest: The first version stays while later ones exist; its start cannot move past the next one.
errors.not_found: This rate version no longer exists.

import.title: Import placements

sourceHint.bullhorn: A placement list exported as CSV.
sourceHint.other: Any CSV or Excel file with one placement per row.

import.whichSource: Where do the placements come from?
import.accepted: CSV or Excel (.xlsx), up to 10 MB and 2,000 rows. Columns that may hold Social Security numbers or birth dates are removed when the file is received.

refused.unsupported: Only CSV and Excel (.xlsx) files can be imported.
refused.empty: The file has no header row or no rows.
refused.too_large: The file is larger than 10 MB.
refused.busy: Someone else is changing job orders or paying a week right now. Try again in a moment.
refused.stale: This import changed in another tab or window. The page now shows the latest.
refused.too_many_rows: An import takes at most 2,000 rows. Split the file and import each part.
refused.no_header: The first row must hold column names. In this file it holds a date or a number shaped like a Social Security number, so it looks like a placement. Add a row of column names at the top and upload again.

import.mapBody: Match each column in the file to a Shiftbook field. Columns left as "Don't import" are skipped.
import.valuesBody: Each value in the file, with how many rows have it. Choosing a match fixes every row with that value. Workers are only matched to the roster, never created.
import.unresolved: {count, plural, one {# value still needs a match or to be left out} other {# values still need a match or to be left out}}.
import.previewNote: Rates that differ from the job order's become the worker's own rates from their start date. Nothing is written until you start the import.

reasons.twice_in_file: Placement {value} appears twice in the file.
reasons.left_out: Left out in the review step ({value}).
reasons.several_on_roster: {value} matches more than one worker on the roster.
reasons.new_job_order_needs_worksite: No job order {value} at this client; choose an existing one or a worksite for a new one.
reasons.several_job_orders: More than one job order matches {value}.
reasons.end_before_start: The end date {value} is before the start date.
reasons.invalid_rate: "{value}" is not a rate (use a period for cents, like 18.25).
reasons.overlaps: The worker already has an assignment on this job order for those dates.
reasons.rates_refused: The rates could not be added: {value}.
reasons.job_order_refused: The new job order {value} could not be created.
reasons.worker_not_found: The worker is no longer on the roster.
reasons.job_order_not_found: The job order no longer exists.
reasons.end_before_start_assignment: The end date is before the start date.
reasons.status_unclear: The status "{value}" is not clear; choose what it means in the review step.
reasons.could_not_save: This row could not be saved.

datesRead.month_first: Dates like 10/05/2026 are read month first (October 5). You can change this in Review values.
datesRead.day_first: Dates like 05/10/2026 are read day first (5 October). You can change this in Review values.

rateRefusals.paid: a paid week already uses these dates
rateRefusals.same_start: a version already starts that day
rateRefusals.no_default_multipliers: no default overtime multipliers are set for the agency

import.removedTitle: {count, plural, one {# column was removed when the file was received} other {# columns were removed when the file was received}}
import.removedBody: They were never stored or shown. If you need one of them, take the sensitive values out of the file and upload it again.

removedReason.heading: its heading names a Social Security number, tax ID or birth date
removedReason.ssn_values: it holds numbers shaped like Social Security numbers
removedReason.birth_dates: it holds birth dates (most of its dates are 14 or more years old, or a date sits next to a word like DOB)

dateOrder.auto: Chosen from the file's dates. Change it if the dates below are read wrong.

import.invalidFormat: Invalid format: rows with it are skipped
import.invalidDates: {count, plural, one {# date} other {# dates}} with an invalid format
